_comment: The SAME job order as job-order-bullhorn.json, in CEIPAL's shape: flat fields, different names, a skills ARRAY of objects instead of a comma string, and a pay range object instead of a number. Nothing in any of the three workflows changes to handle this - only ATS_FIELDS.job in the config node. That substitution is the whole multi-client story, and it is worth showing on camera.
job_description: Distribution centre in Calder City is hiring experienced forklift operators for first shift, Monday to Friday, 6am to 2:30pm. Sit-down and stand-up reach trucks. RF scanner experience preferred. OSHA certification a plus.
